title: Low quality products and not as promised
text: According to the product description, "NEW subscribers will receive the Editor's Choice Box or Member's Favorites Box as their first box and then go on to the normal renewal schedule for the next renewal."  Instead, I received the Fall 2020 box as my first box in March of 2021.  Aside from a name brand mug, laptop cleaner, and egg timer, the rest of the items were strange knockoffs of very questionable quality.  I'm still not sure what's innovative about a small bottle of soap?  Even if I use the MSRPs listed in my product catalog, which are clearly pretty high for some of the items, the discount was around 25% which isn't stellar for a box of things I didn't necessarily want.  Cancelled my subscription after the one box.
label: negative
